import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
base_r = 25      # 基圆半径 (mm)
lobe_r = 35      # 凸起半径 (mm)
thickness = 10   # 厚度 (mm)
bore = 8         # 轴孔直径 (mm)
offset = 8       # 偏心量 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
# 基圆
base = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(base_r)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# 凸起（偏心圆）
lobe = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0, offset)
    .circle(lobe_r - offset)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

result = base.union(lobe)

# 轴孔
result = result.faces(">Z").workplane().hole(bore)

show_object(result)
